g.text: Selected energy: one lattice; energy is free
One fixed equation carries a continuum of lattices; h = 216 g₃ is its first-integral parameter.
The endpoints h = ±1 are degenerations. The open segment between them has Δ > 0.
Lattice of the full twisted period group Γ · Real invariants do not alone imply a bounded real profile.
